description: Initial weak-focus prototype used only a 0.24 focus-centroid blend, without joint focus-consensus gating. KK -> pronoun dark matter drifted toward generic dark matter; a further decay query lost the tower context. Superseded by generic joint conditioning and refreshed focus. Derive/phenomenology intent cues were also subsequently made domain neutral. These are actual observed source-linked rankings, not a reproduction claim for current engine.

top.title: Kaluza–Klein tower and bubble nucleation in six dimensional Einstein–Maxwell theory
top.text: How do flux and uplift control KK masses, curvature-scale separation, and Minkowski limits, and does KK-tower descent obstruct flux-bubble transitions to ‘nothing’ or constrain metastable de Sitter vacua through the distance and cobordism conjectures?

top.title: Black Hole-Tower Correspondence: Species backreaction in minimal black hole limits
top.text: Does the black hole–tower correspondence survive gravitational backreaction of KK species, which tower dominates when strings and KK modes coexist, and can the corresponding Euclidean phases be continuously connected?

top.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua
top.text: Does the KK tower decouple from AdS curvature as the cosmological constant approaches zero? The diagnostic compares a squared KK mass with curvature, normalized consistently in the lower-dimensional theory.

top.title: Kaluza-Klein tower thresholds and scheme dependence of the species scale
top.text: How do cutoff profiles affect local four-derivative thresholds from infinite KK towers, and which large-N terms remain stable? The aim is to assess the parametric correspondence between perturbative-breakdown and higher-derivative characterizations of the species scale.

top.title: Alice in Warpland: KK modes, Warped Compactifications and the Swampland
top.text: Can persistent warping reduce the exponential lightening rate of scalar KK towers below the Sharpened Distance Conjecture bound, and how does this depend on the higher-dimensional potential and defect codimension?

rankings.query: what if they are dark matter?

top.title: Nonthermal production of dark radiation and dark matter
top.text: Can nonthermal production reconcile dark matter with detectable visible-sector interactions and sufficiently cold dark radiation, while generating both baryonic and dark matter asymmetries?

top.title: Observational constraints on variable equation of state parameters of dark matter and dark energy after Planck
top.text: What constraints do the specified supernova, BAO, CMB and matter-power data place on time-dependent CPL equations of state for both dark matter and dark energy, and do these fluid-model constraints indicate significant departure from cold dark matter?

top.title: Dark dimension gravitons as dark matter
top.text: Can gravitational production from a hot Standard Model brane supply viable dark matter in the dark dimension, while relating its abundance to the dark-energy scale?

top.title: Dark Matter meets Quantum Gravity
top.text: Which minimal thermal dark-matter models admit an asymptotically safe gravity–matter embedding, and what restrictions do the resulting Planck-scale boundary conditions place on low-energy portal couplings and dark-matter masses?

top.title: Cold and fuzzy dark matter
top.text: Can free, ultralight scalar dark matter suppress dwarf-scale cusps and excessive low-mass halo formation through its wave properties, while retaining the large-scale benefits of cold dark matter?

top.title: Cosmology of gravitational axions
top.text: Compute the redshifted two-graviton decay spectrum from a monochromatic emission kernel, decay depletion and entropy evolution. The illustrated spectra assume radiation-dominated decay and no competing decay channel.

top.title: Gravitinos from heavy scalar decay
top.text: Add thermal-scattering and direct-decay gravitino yields, translate historical abundance and structure-formation constraints, and minimize the total yield using YTH+YX≥2√(YTHYX). Analyze both Planck-suppressed total decay and a freely parameterized reheating temperature.

top.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant
top.text: Perturbative inflaton-decay widths into gauge bosons or matter fields are translated into reheating temperatures. For reheating below dark-matter freeze-out, the paper estimates the direct inflaton-decay contribution to the relic yield.

top.title: The Baryon-Dark Matter Ratio Via Moduli Decay After Affleck-Dine Baryogenesis
top.text: Tracks baryon and modulus yields through cosmological expansion and uses their pre-decay ratio to compute entropy dilution. Parameterizes gravitational modulus decay by ΓX = DX mX³/Mp² and relates the final reheating temperature to √(ΓX Mp).

top.title: Gravitino production from heavy moduli decay and cosmological moduli problem revived
top.text: Estimate decay temperatures by Γ ≈ H, the gravitino yield from modulus reheating, and the residual neutralino abundance from annihilation freeze-out at ⟨σv⟩nχ ≈ H(T3/2). The paper uses this estimate rather than solving the Boltzmann equations.
